flops.coverage: Unregistered dispatched ops after decomposition are listed, not assigned zero true cost. Bias, normalization, activations, softmax, RoPE, interpolation, memory traffic and Python can be absent or partial. Counts are not exact total work.
flops.not_executed: null FLOPs means present but not called in static path, never a zero-cost model

timing_exclusions: Downloads, model construction, TIFF IO, CPU radiometry/resize/normalization, H2D/D2H, feature hooks/capture, gradients, figure generation, persistence and automatic pipeline excluded. SAM includes forward_image (conv_s0/s1), spatial reshape/no_mem, fixed prompt encoding/dense PE, decoder and native logits bilinear resize. DINO includes embeddings/RoPE/all layers/final norm. Block replay is isolated and not additive; conv_s0/s1 called outside decoder are residual in full FLOP accounting.
